newsitem.title: USA: Xerox completes buy of Rank Xerox.
newsitem.headline: Xerox completes buy of Rank Xerox.

text.p: STAMFORD, Conn., June 30 - Xerox Corp said on Monday it completed the $1.5 billion acquisition of Rank Xerox after buying the remaining 20 percent stake held by Rank Group Plc .
Xerox now owns 100 percent ownership of the manufacturing and marketing organization for Europe and parts of Asia and Africa, it said.

Xerox said Rank Group shareholders on Moday approved the deal, valued at 940 million pounds, or about $1.5 billion. Xerox said on June 6 it would suspend a $1 billion stock buyback program to help pay for the acquisition.

Xerox said it paid the Rank Group 500 million pounds at the closing Monday. The company said it would pay the balance of 220 million pounds in two installments: half within one year and the other half at the end of two years from today.
The company added it could pay an additional 60 million pounds in the year 2000 "based on achievement of significant Rank Xerox earnings growth targets by 1999."

Xerox reported a net income of $270 million, or $0.75 a share, in the first quarter, compared with $237 million, or $0.65 a share, the year before. Its stock traded at 78-9/16 Monday morning, down 5/16.
Rank Xerox will be changing its name to Xerox Limited, according to Xerox.
